lines.lyric_translation: I’ve been hiding it / I tell you something
Just to leave it buried
Now I can’t endure it anymore
Why couldn’t I say it then
I have been hurting anyway
Really I won’t be able to endure it

lines.lyric_hangul: Now cry 너에게 너무 미안할 뿐야
lines.lyric_translation: Now cry / It’s only that I’m very sorry towards you
Again, cry because I couldn’t protect you

lines.lyric: Deo gipi deo gipi sangcheoman gipeojyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 더 깊이 더 깊이 상처만 깊어져
lines.lyric_translation: Deeper, deeper, the wound just gets deeper

lines.lyric: Doedollil su eobneun kkaejin yuri jogak gata
lines.lyric_hangul: 되돌릴 수 없는 깨진 유리 조각 같아
lines.lyric_translation: Like pieces of broken glass that I can’t reverse
Deeper, it’s just the heart that hurts every day
(You) who was punished in my stead,
You who were only delicate and fragile
Stop crying, tell me something
Try saying to me, who had no courage

lines.lyric_hangul: 그 때 나한테 왜 그랬어 미안
lines.lyric_translation: Why did you do that to me then / I’m sorry
Forget it,
what right do I have
To tell you to do this, or that

lines.lyric: Deo gipi deo gipi sangcheoman gipeojyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 더 깊이 더 깊이 상처만 깊어져
lines.lyric_translation: Deeper, deeper, the wound just gets deeper

lines.lyric: Doedollil su eobneun kkaejin yuri jogak gata
lines.lyric_hangul: 되돌릴 수 없는 깨진 유리 조각 같아
lines.lyric_translation: Like pieces of broken glass that I can’t reverse
Deeper, it’s just the heart that hurts every day
(You) who was punished in my stead,
You who were only delicate and fragile
I’m sorry I’m sorry
I’m sorry ma brother
Even if (I try to) hide it, or conceal it, it can’t be erased

lines.lyric_hangul: Are you calling me a sinner
lines.lyric_translation: Are you calling me a sinner
What more do I have to say
I’m sorry I’m sorry
I’m sorry ma sister
Even if (I try to) hide it, or conceal it, it can’t be erased
So cry
Please dry my eyes

lines.lyric: Jeo bichi jeo bichi nae joereul bichwojwo
lines.lyric_hangul: 저 빛이 저 빛이 내 죄를 비춰줘
lines.lyric_translation: That light, that light, please illuminate my sins

lines.lyric: Dorikil su eobneun burgeun piga heulleonaeryeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 돌이킬 수 없는 붉은 피가 흘러내려
lines.lyric_translation: Where I can’t turn back the red blood is flowing down

lines.lyric: Deo gipi maeiri jugeul geoman gata
lines.lyric_hangul: 더 깊이 매일이 죽을 것만 같아
lines.lyric_translation: Deeper, I feel like dying every day
Please let me be punished
Please forgive me for my sins / Please
